flash: Choose whether to put your %{DEVICE_NAME} into Force Recovery Mode via Manual Setup or Automatic Setup. Choose Automatic Setup only if the device has already been flashed and is currently running.
recoveryAuto: Ensure the device has already been flashed, powered and running.
Connect the host computer to the USB Type-C connector [J81] on the device, the one next to the HDMI output.
Enter the connection information of your %{DEVICE_NAME}.
recoveryManual: Make sure the device is connected to the power adapter, but powered off.
Connect the host computer to the USB Type-C connector [J81] on the device, the one next to the HDMI output.
Press and hold the middle (Force Recovery) button.
Press and hold the left (Power) button.
targetAccess: Complete the Ubuntu 'System configuration wizard' on your %{targetName}, if you have chosen to configure it manually before flashing.
Wait for the OS login screen.
If proxy is used on host, also configure apt proxy on your %{targetName}.
Enter the username and password of your %{targetName}.
